mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly lowers discount rates for equity valuation models, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.2pp quarterly rise in unemployment rate signals imminent labor market deterioration, triggering corporate profit warnings and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 0.2pp rise).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint HOUST/RSAFS decline fails to predict negative returns in >40% of cases (positive returns >40% of instances).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY) forces aggressive Fed tightening, increasing discount rates and suppressing equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY periods.

mechanism_narrative: Robust industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.0% MoM) signals strong economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive returns in >40% of cases (negative returns >40% of instances).

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth below 1.0% annualized signals economic deceleration, reducing corporate profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where GDPC1 growth < 1.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market contraction, predicting recession and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Joint PAYEMS decline/UNRATE rise fails to predict negative returns in >40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) increases borrowing costs, reducing corporate investment and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS > 4.0% periods.
